note: Unknown top-level payload member — additionalProperties: false catches `badgeId`; the settings are the community's one record and take no selector.
The settings are never sent to be read; a request carrying `settings` is an update mistaken for a read.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
The response carries the whole settings record: `settings` is REQUIRED.
`settings` is the shared BadgeSettings shape, every required switch present; a record missing `kudosMakers` cannot tell a portal whether its member may make a kudos badge.
